name: fastdl-sync
description: Automatic Fast Download (sv_downloadurl) content sync. Scans game servers for downloadable content (maps, models, sounds, materials) and mirrors it to a FastDL server on the same node — upload once, clients get everything.
author: Catalyst Team

syncIntervalCron.description: Cron schedule for automatic syncs (panel timezone)

generateBzip2.description: Generate .bz2 twins for large files (cuts HL1 client bandwidth 60-80%, costs CPU per sync)

bz2MinSizeMb.description: Only generate .bz2 twins for files at least this large

deleteRemoved.description: Delete FastDL copies when the source file is deleted or excluded
